sources.retained: Viscous stress production -2nu G remains in the source; positivity of the explicit diffusion block does not pay it.

diffusion.diffusion: D=nu sum_j int (partial_j z)^T H_z (I+N/sqrt(2)) partial_j z
diffusion.bound: D >= (nu/2) sum_j int (partial_j z)^T H_z partial_j z >= (4nu/3) int |grad |z|^(3/2)|^2
diffusion.matrix_argument: For B^2=0, split a vector orthogonally over ker B and its complement: |<v,Bv>| <= ||B|| |v|^2/2. Apply to H_z^(1/2) N H_z^(-1/2), whose norm is at most sqrt(2).
diffusion.scope: Actual pressure observations satisfy the block system. The source is not independently prescribed; the remaining payment is open.

calibration.scope: Exact actual-flow calibration; not a bound on arbitrary generated-pressure histories.

payment.beta_norm: ||beta||2^2 <= C_S^(3/2) E(t)^(3/2) Z(t)^(1/2), uniform in fixed L
payment.proof: Dual Sobolev and the exact tensor-to-vector pressure multiplier, then interpolation. All current velocity components and stress cross terms remain.
payment.payment: B_low_prime+|W_low|<=0 almost everywhere; extend endpoints by continuity
payment.periodic_kernel: M_L=sum_(k !=0) |k| exp(-L^2 |k|^2), for normalized period-2pi volume
payment.zero_energy: u=0 and every cost/reserve is zero
payment.seams: The same E(t), pressure state and remaining original horizon are inherited; no new allowance is issued.

consumer.OPEN: int_0^T [F_gen-D/2] <= K_gen(u0,nu,H,L) for EVERY available same-datum prefix T<=H
consumer.periodic: int_0^T ||u||9^3 <= C_I [3/(2nu)+H] A0; C_I is the inhomogeneous Sobolev constant
consumer.continuation: Gronwall gives one datum-only order-one bound if the OPEN source allowance is proved; the existing continuation consumer then applies.
consumer.adverse_horizontal_variant: For z=(u_h,sqrt(2) grad_h q/nu), the existing Gaussian certificate gives positive initial nonlinear pressure production at large amplitude. It refutes automatic monotonicity of that projected variant.
consumer.distinction: The full three-component pressure norm has a different coefficient; the horizontal sign is not asserted for it. No integrated source payment or regularity theorem is proved.
